Objective: The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a DSMES program coupled with CGM on hemoglobin A 1c
(HbA1c) and CGM-derived glycemic measures compared to usual care for adults with type 2 diabetes over 6 months.
Methods: Participants with type 2 diabetes and HbA 1c of 8% or higher (64 mmol/mol) who were not using mealtime bolus
insulin (aged 26 ‐83 y; mean HbA 1c 9.6%, SD 1.4% [mean 81.2 mmol/mol, SD 15.8 mmol/mol]) were randomly assigned to
a digital DSMES+CGM integrated solution (n=51) or usual care (n=49) for 6 months. The primary outcome was HbA 1c. The
secondary outcomes were CGM-derived glycemic measures, including glucose management indicator, percent time in range
70 to 180 mg/dL, percent time above range (>180 mg/dL), percent time below range (<70 mg/dL), and mean glucose. Linear
mixed effects models were used for intention-to-treat analyses.
